programme.title: Bad Education (Director's Cut)
programme.desc: On the night of their high school graduation, three juvenile delinquents find themselves getting drunk at their regular hangout, throwing beer bottles and enjoying the abuse hurled at them by nearby residents. But for these young men about to enter a new chapter of life, this little bit of chaos is nowhere near enough to farewell their dying youth. Before dawn, they decide to share their deepest, darkest secret with one another. After all, only true “bros” are qualified to know their most unspeakable deed...

Thomas & Uber Cup Finals 2026 Review Show
The Melon Patch S1E6 -Family Love!
programme.desc: Explore different kinds of families with Ms. Appleberry and the Melon Patch teachers! Discover what makes a family: parents, grandparents, siblings, and pets. Learn that every family is special, unique, and filled with love and care.

programme.title: E7 - Messy Guest, Cracked, Hoppy & Teddy!
programme.desc: The Minibods are dealing with a messy guest, a cracked egg, a hoppy friend & a ruined teddy! Jeff meets a cute but very messy Floofer & has to learn to live with his new friend's untidy habits. Then, Lulu finds a colorful egg, & when it cracks, a cute chick hatches that she doesn't want to let go! The challenges continue as Newt tries to nurse an injured Oddfrog back to health & Pogo feels guilty after accidentally ruining Newt's teddy bear-shaped hedge.

programme.title: E2 - Let's Sing Our Favorite Classic Songs!
programme.desc: Come sing your favorite classic songs with Kii & Yii! The sing-along starts on Old MacDonald's farm, where the friends learn how to spell the friendly dog's name in the song 'Bingo'! Then, listen as Mr. Cat sings a story about his grand adventure visiting the Queen in her palace. The fun continues with the story of the Lion & the Unicorn, the flying adventure of 'Two Little Dicky Birds' & a song about the Old Woman Who Lived in a Shoe.

programme.title: E1 - From Dinosaurs To Pet Knights!
programme.desc: Blippi is on an adventure from dinosaurs to pet knights! He travels back in time with Tabbs to help a little Microraptor prove that being small has its benefits when they rescue a giant sauropod from the mud. Then, they head to the African savannah to learn how to roar, sneak & pounce like a lion! Back at the clubhouse, Blippi learns how to interpret a puppy's tail wags & even travels back in time again to help a real-life knight in shining armor—who happens to be a corgi!

programme.title: The Melon Patch S1E5 -It's Bath Time!
programme.desc: Ms. Appleberry and the Melon Patch teachers explore how bathtime is fun and teach kids the importance of getting clean. We discover the importance of bathtime through bubble play, modeling healthy hygiene habits, and a good night's sleep!

programme.title: E13 - A Birthday Full of Surprises!
programme.desc: It's a day of celebrations with Baby John! First, it's his birthday with cake and presents. Then, he accidentally ruins his sister Jill's spa party. Finally, he uses his imagination to travel to a prehistoric world for Dino's birthday!

programme.title: E6 - A Very Happy Birthday!
programme.desc: Join Cody for a fantastic birthday adventure at Dinoland! Afterward, ride the bus with his family, play peek-a-boo, and welcome his new baby sister, Kendi. It's a day of family fun, games, and sweet surprises.

programme.title: E2 - Little Problems, Big Adventures!
programme.desc: Mila & Morphle are turning little problems into big adventures! When Mr. Vanderboos accidentally sprays hair growth serum on Daddy, Officer Freeze mistakes him for a hairy monster, & a wild chase begins! Then, Mila has a bad cold, but she still has to help Morphle figure out the right morphs to rescue a dog stuck in a tree. From playing a quiet game to avoid waking a napping neighbor to playing hide & seek with friends, every little problem is a big adventure!

programme.title: The Melon Patch S1E6 -Family Love!

programme.title: E2 - A Calming Night with Twinkle!
programme.desc: Have a calming & magical night with Twinkle the star! When Bao Bao struggles to sleep, Twinkle arrives & transforms into a hot air balloon to lift her cot into the night sky so she can see the moon. Then, she helps Max, Muffin & Bao Bao get ready for bed by transforming into a cuddly teddy bear to give them all warm goodnight hugs. From creating a magical rainbow over the bath to turning into a kite for a gentle ride, Twinkle always makes bedtime magical.

programme.title: E10
programme.desc: 芭蕾舞藝術家譚思婷退役歸國，欲與當年被迫分開的戀人馮睿破鏡重圓，但是過去的誤會如同天塹一般隔斷兩人。如今的馮睿獨自一個人帶著孩子，生活如同深潭靜水，譚思婷回來如同一顆石子攪亂了一切。而譚思婷身邊也有一個默默愛了她十年的暗戀者，這次勇敢追愛對她不離不棄。馮睿和譚思婷彼此逃避對方，但是命運的漩渦卻不斷將兩人裡挾其中，令他們愛恨兩難。

programme.desc: 故事講述了周筱風（趙又廷 飾）、方筱然（毛曉彤 飾）和林逸（金世佳 飾）三位心臟科醫生機緣巧合下，在東立醫院心臟中心相遇。三人因專業背景、職業理念不同而產生摩擦碰撞，隨後在治病救人的過程中逐漸磨合達成默契，最終在生命戰場並肩作戰的故事。

programme.title: E3 - Sport And Heritage
programme.desc: In the Arles amphitheatre, Adrien Gavazzi follows a very special lesson with Brice Lopez. Then we head to the Vieux-Port, to the Cercle des Nageurs and the Velodrome Stadium, creating champions of the future. Throughout his journey, he meets the often anonymous heroes, breathing new life into forgotten practices.

programme.title: E5 - Garance Dupont (Paris)/Julien Sebban (Paris)
programme.desc: In Paris, Richard Orlinski meets mosaicist Garance Dupont, who modernises this age-old technique by infusing it with colour and dynamism. Heiress to a family tradition, she shares her meticulous know-how and reveals the mosaic as a vibrant, urban tattoo. Interior architect and designer Julien Sebban fuses traditional craftsmanship with innovation. Opportunities to create universes where antique pieces converse with contemporary works and come to life at Galeries Lafayette as well as at the Plaza?Athenee.
